name: supertranslator
description: Translate public static HTML or local/public text-selectable PDFs into reviewed Korean output, rerender approved translations, or independently compare originals with final HTML/PDF translations.

interface.shortDescription: Translate, rerender, or independently review HTML/PDF.
interface.longDescription: Provides separate translation workflows for public static HTML and local or public text-selectable PDFs, layout-only rendering of existing reviewed HTML bundles and PDF runs, and separately requested full original-to-final semantic and visual comparison.
defaultPrompt: Translate this public HTML page or local/public text-selectable PDF into reviewed Korean output, rerender this existing approved translation without retranslating it, or independently compare this original with its final HTML/PDF translation.
